items.name: Abestar Live - Real-time AI Interpretation Platform
items.content: Real-time AI interpretation for events and meetings: speech is transcribed and translated into six languages live, and listeners follow along on their phones by scanning a QR code, with no app to install. I own architecture, deployment, and AI quality, covering speech recognition feeding LLM translation and correction, fixed-corpus evaluation and cost measurement, and blue-green zero-downtime releases. Live site: live.abestar.com.tw.

items.name: Yuntong Technology - Gaming & Live Interactive Platform
items.content: Yuntong's core platform, split into gaming and live streaming. The gaming side runs on an Nx monorepo with NestJS microservices, each game format broken into its own API, Socket, business service, and async consumer so they scale horizontally on their own under peak-hour traffic. Live at gamilive.com.

items.name: Bound - Interest-Based Social Matching App
items.content: A cross-platform social matching app in Flutter, built around AI matching, interest communities, and chat coaching. I took it from product strategy and UI design through to full-stack implementation; AI jobs run async through SQS with Firebase pushing results back, and moderation is tiered across Claude and Rekognition. Live at bound-app.com.

items.name: Sugarbee - High-End Dating App
items.content: A dating app for a high-end audience, where I owned the frontend, backend, CMS, and operations dashboard: matching engine 2.0, subscription payments and virtual points, real-time chat and push, plus real-person face verification and Rekognition moderation. Live at sugarbee.vip.

items.name: Coffee Chat - Coffee-Break Meetup Platform
items.content: A meetup platform where strangers meet and talk for about as long as one cup of coffee. I did the product, the design, and the full stack on my own. The frontend runs on Next.js App Router with Tailwind, and data and accounts sit on a BaaS. Live at coffee-chat.tw.
